name: Dosyt'
source:
A chance meeting with a former friend keeps going wrong and I don't know what to do. I think I've had enough.

[From [url=https://willardsoroka.itch.io/enough]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与前朋友的一次偶然会面总是出问题，我不知道该怎么办。我想我已经受够了。

[来自[url=https://willardsoroka.itch.io/enough]Itch.io[/url]]
